status: Frozen before external model predictions or controller outcomes; not preregistered
raw_files: Original H*_W.csv minute-sampled power, not processed/interpolated files
capacity_caveat: Paper reports 2.0-2.2 kWp, repository README reports 2.4 kW. These are predeclared reference normalization scales, not verified house-specific nameplates. No full-year peak fitting. All three scales reported.
calendar: 2020-01-01 through 2020-12-31 in source naive clock exactly as recorded; no timezone or hemisphere conversion
external_training: None. Original Oct6 checkpoints and load forecaster frozen in external_model_freeze.json; no external adaptation, tuning, model/scale selection.
time_split: 2020-01-01 to 2020-01-07 only provides initial history; eligible targets 2020-01-08 onward require seven previous valid days. Later observations can enter subsequent history, as day-ahead deployment; no fitting.
household_selection: All original residential files inspected. PV-equipped houses identified by positive production above 10 W in at least 10 minute observations, independent of any prediction/dispatch result; compare count against source ten PV households.

power_channels.GC: direct Consumption(W)/1000, total household electrical demand, not net grid import
power_channels.CL: zero because no separate controlled-load channel is supplied, not a claim that such appliances are absent

battery_boundary: Original households have batteries. Use measured gross load and PV; do not replay observed battery charge/discharge. Simulated fixed study battery is a counterfactual dispatch, not original Irish controller validation.
half_hour_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of nonnegative finite minute power samples in each source-clock half hour; sampled-power approximation, not revenue-meter integrated energy. Retain bin only if >=27 distinct valid minutes (90% coverage) for both GC and GG. Do not interpolate, extrapolate, clip peaks, or impute missing bins.
minute_quality: Ignore non-power extra columns. Parse timestamps; drop all rows at duplicated timestamps so ambiguous minutes contribute no coverage. Reject timestamps not exactly at a minute. Reject nonfinite or negative GC or GG jointly. No sample-based upper cutoff.
day_quality: All 48 half-hour bins must pass for target and each of prior seven days; same pairs for every reference scale and frozen model.
invalid_reporting: Report household coverage, negative/nonfinite/duplicate counts, half-hour coverage, eligible days and season distribution; preserve missing arrays as NaN.
cost_boundary: Retain modeled Australian study tariff and battery parameters for comparability; modeled costs are not actual Irish bills.
claim_boundary: Frozen-model external transfer test across country, calendar, metering and capacity-reference domain shifts. Does not independently validate Ausgrid network effects.
